summary: The eleven-column PG 19 query, selector, privilege behavior, raw-score ordering, wraparound exception, and external cleanup all worked against the real 19beta2 fixture. Both required named mutations went red for the intended assertions. Acceptance is blocked only by a required structural-test omission: the relation expression is not pinned to the outer scores relation, and a joined-side mutation survives the complete AutovacuumScores suite.

findings.issue: The locked-column test checks only the `AS relation` alias and its position; it never asserts the approved outer-side expression `s.schemaname || '.' || s.relname`. The live assertions at lines 127-128 and the rounded-tie fixture also cannot distinguish the outer expression from `a.schemaname || '.' || a.relname`, because naturally occurring fixture rows have join partners. This omits the explicit outer-relation assertion required by tech-spec Testing Strategy lines 378-381. If the expression drifts to the joined side, an unmatched LEFT JOIN row is retained but its relation/UniqueKey value becomes NULL, violating AC-5 without any test failing.
findings.evidence: In a disposable worktree at 7501f003b54bc83315e7970ffbf426a4862f1546, replaced only `SELECT s.schemaname || '.' || s.relname AS relation` with `SELECT a.schemaname || '.' || a.relname AS relation`, then ran `go test ./internal/query/ -run AutovacuumScores -count=1 -v` inside a fresh lesovsky/pgcenter-testing:0.0.11 PG 19 network namespace. The result was `PASS` / `ok ... 1.218s`: structure, live columns/values, both privilege tests, and rounded-tie ordering all passed; only the ordinary-suite dedicated wraparound test skipped. The temporary worktree and containers were removed.
findings.recommendation: Add a named structural assertion for the complete outer expression, for example `assert.Contains(t, PgStatAutovacuumScoresDefault, "SELECT s.schemaname || '.' || s.relname AS relation")`. Mutation-check it by changing both fields to the `a` alias and require that named assertion to fail; retain the live exact-name/value checks.
